## Requirements (from the contract)

1. The sqitch change `ingest_run_report` — append-only (immutability
   trigger, no UPDATE/DELETE grants): `run_id` nullable (C-14),
   `backfilled_from` partial-UNIQUE (`+0` re-run), `link_basis`,
   `clock_basis`, `fetches`, `records_emitted`, `duration_seconds`,
   `robots_outcomes`, `refusal_classes`, `rate_limit_events`,
   `disappearances`, `document_outcomes`, `quota_reached`,
   `budget_reached`, `error_class` (S-4), `per_fetch` (PKG-12 — column
   landed, writer row 312's), `recorded_at`.
2. The `scheduled-ingest` writer — a report row per execution alongside the
   WORM row; unevidenced fields `not_recorded`-typed, never zero-shaped.
3. `sig-ops backfill-run-reports` — one row per WORM row (count re-derived)
   + the C-14 rows (unmatched by matcher verdict; the repo records as
   `repo_record`/`git_only` — the ticket's "90" is its design-time count;
   the directory holds **89** records at this read, and the reader
   re-derives, never assumes); `+0` on re-run.
4. Read-back / verification — reconcile report rows to executions: counts
   per `link_basis`, no execution double-counted, shared-run values never
   presented as the execution's own.
5. Tests under `tests/db` + `tests/ops` — trigger refuses UPDATE/DELETE;
   `+0`; closed vocabularies; unmatched/repo-record shapes; `per_fetch`
   accepts PKG-12; quarantine counts only.
6. Stamps: `SIG-TRANSP-036` (also) + the cited ids — in `pr/P35.32.md`.

## Self-review / gap analysis (closing)

- **One insert path** — `db.run_report.append_report` is the only INSERT;
  both writers (scheduled + backfill) and the ops layer go through it;
  `ON CONFLICT` under both partial UNIQUEs makes every writer `+0`.
- **Link honesty (C-13/C-14)** — `link_basis` says HOW each row links;
  `clock_basis` says where its clock came from; shared `ingest_run`
  values are never copied into execution fields; `started_at` is the
  execution's own or NULL.
- **Evidence-first, never zero-shaped** — every unevidenced field is
  NULL; `not_recorded` classes are explicit, not fabricated counts.
- **S-rules hold** — hosts via S-6 `upstream_host` (never a URL);
  quarantine payload never leaves the private table; closed
  vocabularies mirrored in CHECKs and in code.
- **The recorded narrowing** — `sig_read_public` is not granted; the
  public history is P36.46's surface and rows 311/313 own the views.
- **Honest reds recorded** — the four first-leg findings (SPDX ×2,
  future literal, over-grant) were fixed before push; the three
